parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the consumer group. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. Each Chinese character is counted as two characters.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Instance Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
